stem.text: A square shop sign of uniform density has mass $2.4\,\text{kg}$ and sides of length $0.86\,\text{m}$.
The sign is supported by a hinge along its top edge.
There is friction in the hinge so that the sign hangs from it in equilibrium at an angle of $15^{\circ}$ to the vertical, as shown.

stem.alt: Square sign hanging from a hinge at an angle to a dashed vertical line; labelled hinge, sign, 0.86 m and 15°.

stem.text: What is the moment about the hinge of the weight of the sign?
